title: Kolab: Benchmarking Human-Agent Collaboration in Long-Horizon Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2610.21109v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When humans collaborate with AI agents on long-horizon tasks, what happens to the agents' contributions? For solving long-horizon tasks, humans place greater importance on ongoing interaction with AI agents (e.g., revising plans) than on an agent's ability to complete the task in a single attempt. However, most agentic benchmarks have focused more on automation. Strong performance on such benchmarks does not imply effective real-world collaboration. Professional workflows offer a useful setting, as they often involve interdependent steps. To address this gap, we introduce Kolab, a new dataset of 115+ hours of screen recordings of 50 professionals from 40 occupations collaborating with agents on realistic, long-horizon problems. Kolab also contains participants' collaboration and output quality judgments. Our analysis reveals diverse collaboration patterns, highlighting the importance of when and how professionals coordinate with agents.

translated_title: Kolab：长周期工作流中人机协作的基准测试
translated_abstract: 当人类与AI智能体在长周期任务上协作时，智能体的贡献会带来什么？在解决长周期任务时，人类更加重视与AI智能体的持续交互（例如修订计划），而非智能体一次性完成任务的能力。然而，现有的智能体基准测试大多更侧重于自动化。在这些基准测试上的出色表现并不意味着有效的真实世界协作。专业工作流为此提供了一个有用的研究场景，因为它们通常包含相互依赖的步骤。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了Kolab——一个全新的数据集，包含来自40个职业的50位专业人士与智能体协作解决真实的、长周期问题的超过115小时的屏幕录制。Kolab还包含参与者对协作过程和输出质量的评价。我们的分析揭示了多样化的协作模式，突出了专业人士何时以及如何与智能体进行协调的重要性。
tldr: 本文推出Kolab数据集，通过记录50位来自40个职业的专业人士与AI智能体协作处理真实长周期任务的115小时以上屏幕录像，揭示了人类更重视与智能体的持续交互而非一次性自动化完成，说明现有侧重自动化的基准测试无法衡量真实世界的人机协作效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Kolab, a dataset of 115+ hours of screen recordings capturing 50 professionals from 40 occupations collaborating with AI agents on realistic long-horizon tasks, revealing that humans value ongoing interaction over single-attempt automation and that existing automation-focused benchmarks fail to measure effective real-world human-agent collaboration.
